name: mcp-context-protector
description: A security wrapper for MCP servers that provides trust-on-first-use pinning, guardrail scanning, and protection against prompt injection attacks. It acts as an intermediary layer to ensure universal compatibility and secure enforcement of server configurations across various MCP host applications.
